simple.meaning: blood (as that which when shed causes death) of man or an animal; by analogy, the juice of the grape; figuratively (especially in the plural) bloodshed (i.e. drops of blood)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דָּם (H1818) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 361 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: דָּם (dâm) means blood (as that which when shed causes death) of man or an animal; by analogy, the juice of the grape; figuratively (especially in the plural) bloodshed (i.e. drops of blood) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 11 19.
